title: DevSecOps Blast Radius Estimate
description: Typed blast-radius estimate derived from a GAIA topology snapshot. Supplies affected service scope, customer impact class, and evidence linkage for Workroom incident investigation. GAIA is the blast-radius authority — Prophet Platform validates estimate references only.

topology_ref.description: The topology snapshot this blast-radius estimate is derived from.

affected_services.description: Service refs confirmed or strongly supported as affected by the incident.

potentially_affected_services.description: Service refs that may be affected based on topology traversal but not confirmed.

customer_impact_class.description: Estimated customer impact class. 'high' requires evidence_refs.

confidence.description: 'none' means no causal estimate can be made from available topology.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence packets supporting this blast-radius estimate.
